name: Making Sense of It
summary: J.D. Collie studies the information you brought about the pylons. She asks you to return in a moment for her answer.

sections.title: Collie's Findings
sections.body: Her calculations are ready when you speak with J.D. Collie again. She has gathered her conclusions into a manual and believes she can answer your questions about the crystals.

faq.q: Who is working out the pylon information?
faq.answer: J.D. Collie is studying the information you gave her about the pylons.

faq.q: What does J.D. Collie ask me to do?
faq.answer: J.D. Collie asks you to speak with her again in a moment while she makes calculations.
J.D. Collie compiles her findings into a manual and says she can answer questions about the crystals.

attribution: In-game quest text: Making Sense of It
